scores.claim_text: Skoda Group partnership (Nov 5, 2025) for 37Ah LTO cell rail battery; prototype EMU vehicles by end of 2026, deployment 2027.
supports: edgar_fts.query_fulltext(Microvast, forms=20-F/40-F)=13 hits, none from Skoda Group (matches are Electrovaya, REE Automotive, CNH Industrial, DAQO).
edgar_fts.query_fulltext(Skoda)=133 hits, but Skoda Group (Czech rail-vehicle OEM) is private and not an SEC filer; matches are Skoda Auto dealer references.
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext for counterparty disclosure of foreign private OEM
scores.M_value: No SEC-filer corroboration available; Skoda Group is non-US, non-SEC-filer
scores.interpretation: Calibration Heuristic 2 (foreign-issuer caveat) and Heuristic 3 (planned vs operational stage) both apply. This is a pre-SOP joint-development claim — prototypes end-2026, deployment 2027 — so no recognition obligation yet at any OEM. UNVERIFIABLE rather than false-clean. The 37Ah LTO platform aligns with MVST's existing LTO chemistry portfolio (a real technology, not novel).

scores.claim_text: Solid-state battery: 320 Wh/kg in bench-scale validation; 'prototype, bench-scale results may not be indicative of mass production performance'.
supports: uspto_odp.query_assignee(Microvast)=116 applications, 54 granted patents, 12 in solid-state category (titles mentioning 'solid' or 'sulfide'); 75 in general battery category.
Example: PCTUS2025012252 'COMPOSITE ELECTRODE PLATE AND MANUFACTURING METHOD THEREFOR, AND SOLID STATE BATTERY' filed Jan 2025 by Microvast, Inc.
scores.M_check: uspto_odp.query_assignee for patent depth in claimed technology area
scores.M_value: n_granted=54 (>= Heuristic 8 threshold of 10), 12 solid-state applications confirm active solid-state IP work
scores.interpretation: Calibration Heuristic 8 (patents) passes — well above 10 granted threshold with strong claimed-technology hits. Critically, the company EXPLICITLY discloses the 320 Wh/kg figure as 'bench-scale' with no SOP date, no production capacity, no OEM design-win attached. This is a research-paper milestone honestly framed — no JDA-to-SOP conflation (Heuristic 3). The disclosure itself includes the caveat 'may not be indicative of mass production performance.' PASS for honest disclosure quality, with the understanding that solid-state is far from commercial.

scores.claim_text: NMC 53.5Ah cell: ~235 Wh/kg, up to 6,000 cycles at 1C / room-temp / >80% SOH; produced at Huzhou, China.
supports: Claim includes test conditions (1C rate, room temperature, >80% SOH endpoint) — satisfies Heuristic 9 disclosure-quality requirement.
uspto_odp.query_assignee(Microvast) confirms 75 battery-category patents underpinning NMC cell development.
Filing acknowledges 'Third-party evaluations from U.S. National Labs and Technischer berwachungsverein (TUV) have validated our performance claims.'
scores.M_value: Test conditions ARE disclosed (1C, RT, 80% SOH cutoff) — meets the rate/T/DoD requirement
scores.interpretation: Heuristic 9 (energy-density with test conditions) PASS. Unlike many SPAC-battery names that quote unconditioned Wh/kg numbers, MVST cites 1C/RT/80% endpoint and acknowledges third-party validation. The cell is in commercial production at Huzhou (real LTO/NMC volumes shipping to Chinese commercial-vehicle OEMs). The energy density (~235 Wh/kg) is plausible for an NMC811-class commercial vehicle cell.

scores.claim_text: Clarksville, TN 577,000 sq ft owned facility for ESS/LFP cell production; construction slowed Q4 2023 due to financing; $19.95M DPR Construction lien dispute; $23.6M total liens received.
supports: epa_frs.query_facilities(Microvast, TN)=1 facility, but it is 'TVA HERTZ TN DELIVERY POINT TO MICROVAST' — a utility power-delivery point, NOT an EPA-permitted Microvast manufacturing facility.
Same result with city_filter=Clarksville — no Microvast-operated EPA-regulated facility in Tennessee.
Filing acknowledges Clarksville expansion is incomplete, repurposed from 53.5Ah to LFP, blocked by mechanics liens, subject to WARN-Act layoff settlement, restated impairment charge.
scores.M_value: Zero Microvast operating facilities in EPA FRS for TN; only a TVA utility delivery point exists
scores.interpretation: Heuristic 1 (EPA FRS scope) — battery production facilities ARE EPA-regulated for hazmat / air permits. Absence of a Microvast-named EPA-permitted facility in TN, despite a 577,000 sq ft 'owned manufacturing' property, confirms the structure exists but is NOT operating as a permitted battery factory. The disclosed mechanics liens ($23.6M), WARN-Act layoff class action, $19.95M unpaid contractor dispute, and impairment-restatement all corroborate that Clarksville is a stranded asset, not a producing US factory. SEVERE_UNDERDELIVERY relative to the original 2021 promise of US-domestic Clarksville production by 2023-2024.

scores.claim_text: Loss of conditional DOE grant; subject of stockholder demands and Schelling securities class action.
supports: usaspending.query_recipient_contracts(Microvast)=0 federal contracts — no DoD / DOE contract revenue.
usaspending.query_recipient_grants(Microvast)=1 small grant: DEEE0008366, $499,972 (a minor DOE financial assistance award) — NOT the major ~$200M conditional DOE grant that the company referenced.

Filing itself confirms 'loss of a conditional grant from the United States Department of Energy' and pending securities class action (Schelling v. Microvast, S.D. Tex., motion to dismiss granted in part Aug 2025; discovery in progress).
scores.M_check: usaspending.query_recipient_contracts / grants for DOE award verification
scores.M_value: Only $499,972 in cumulative DOE-grant assistance; no large-dollar DOE LPO / grant present
scores.interpretation: Heuristic 5 (USAspending DOE coverage) — major DOE LPO and grant awards DO show up. The absence of any large MVST DOE award post-cutoff confirms the rescission. The company itself acknowledges loss of the conditional grant and resulting securities litigation, with class certification briefing scheduled for June-October 2026. This is a hard adverse signal: a flagship US-policy win that did not materialize, plus active securities-fraud allegations centered on that very disclosure. RED_FLAG_NEGATIVE — both the operational loss and the active litigation overhang.

scores.claim_text: Going-concern doubt initially raised; $169.2M cash (only $105M unrestricted; $62.2M trapped in China + Europe subsidiaries); $140.9M convertible loan at SOFR+9.75%; stock at $2.10 vs $11.50 warrant strike.
supports: Self-disclosed: 'substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern' raised, with management mitigation plan based on operating cash flow + refinancing + ATM offering.
edgar_fts.query_fulltext(Microvast 8-K, CIK 1760689)=179 hits including frequent capital-raising / ATM / amendment 8-Ks consistent with chronic refinancing activity.
Convertible loan at SOFR+9.75% (3.75% PIK + cash) is distressed-credit pricing, not investment-grade.
Stock $2.10 vs $11.50 warrant strike = 82% out of the money; warrants effectively worthless; standard de-SPAC battery distress fingerprint.
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext for capital-event 8-K cadence; self-disclosure of going concern
scores.M_value: Going-concern doubt + distressed convertible coupon + trapped foreign cash + sub-$3 share price
scores.interpretation: Heuristic 10 (delisting / going-concern fingerprints) — multiple distress markers present. Critically, $62.2M of cash is held in China/Europe subsidiaries and is NOT readily repatriable due to PRC FX controls + adverse US tax — effectively the US parent has only ~$43M of usable cash against $140.9M of distressed convertible debt and $19.95M+ in unpaid US construction liens. The going-concern qualification was 'alleviated' contingent on assumed refinancing and ATM dilution — both of which compound dilution risk for equity holders. RED_FLAG_NEGATIVE.

scores.claim_text: Order backlog of $196.1M as of YE2025, majority expected fulfilled in 2026 and 2027.
supports: edgar_fts.query_fulltext(Microvast, CIK Ford 0000037996)=0 hits — Ford does not mention Microvast.
edgar_fts.query_fulltext(Microvast, CIK GM 0001467858)=0 hits — GM does not mention Microvast.
Backlog disclosed as a single aggregate number with no customer concentration breakdown, no signed-PO vs LOI split.
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext for top-tier US OEM corroboration
scores.M_value: No US OEM (Ford/GM) disclosure of Microvast as a counterparty
scores.interpretation: MVST does not claim Ford or GM as customers, so the Ford/GM absence is not a contradiction. However, $196.1M of backlog (~12 months of revenue at current run rate) with no segmentation between firm POs and indicative orders, and 'majority' fulfilled across 2026 AND 2027 (i.e., back-end loaded), against a going-concern backdrop and Huzhou Phase 3.2 ramp risk, is soft. Heuristic 11 (revenue-recognition pattern) — at MVST's stage with material restatement history, an undifferentiated backlog should be discounted. MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY for disclosure granularity, not for fabricated revenue.

scores.claim_text: Customer base: IVECO eDaily, Citybus/Intercity/Crossway buses; BAIC Truck, Higer Bus, JBM Electric Vehicles, Kalmar Corp., XCMG, LGMG.
supports: edgar_fts.query_fulltext('IVECO Microvast')=0 hits as a phrase (likely too long).
edgar_fts.query_fulltext(Microvast, forms=20-F)=10 hits including CNH Industrial NV 20-F (CNH was the parent of IVECO prior to the 2022 spin-off; IVECO Group NV is foreign and does not file 20-F).
BAIC, Higer, JBM, XCMG, LGMG are Chinese OEMs / equipment makers — no SEC filings.
scores.M_value: All named customers are foreign (Italian/Czech/Chinese/Finnish) and do not file with SEC; CNH 20-F historical reference exists but doesn't confirm current Microvast supply
scores.interpretation: Heuristic 2 (foreign-issuer caveat) applies broadly — IVECO Group NV, Kalmar Corp. (Finnish), Skoda, BAIC, Higer, JBM, XCMG, LGMG are all non-SEC filers. The framework cannot independently corroborate via US filings. UNVERIFIABLE. Importantly, this is a structurally different customer profile from typical solid-state cohort peers (QS/SES/SLDP target US/German auto OEMs); MVST is a real commercial-vehicle battery supplier shipping today, mostly in China — which is qualitatively consistent with its disclosed Huzhou-centric revenue concentration.

scores.claim_text: Restatement of Q2 2024 and Q3 2024 quarterly financial statements due to Clarksville facility impairment error; material weakness in internal controls.
supports: edgar_fts.query_fulltext('restatement', CIK 0001760689)=18 hits.
Including 10-Q/A filed 2025-03-31 (accession 0001760689-25-000006) for the Sep 30 2024 period — confirming the restatement filing.
Self-disclosed material weakness in ICFR; loss of smaller-reporting-company status effective Dec 31 2025 will require expanded disclosures from Q1 2026 onward.
scores.M_value: Restatement confirmed via 10-Q/A filing; multiple restatement references in MVST's own filings
scores.interpretation: Restatement is corroborated by the actual 10-Q/A filing in EDGAR. Heuristic 11 (revenue-recognition pattern) is adjacent — material weakness + restatement focused on the SAME asset (Clarksville) that is the subject of mechanics liens, WARN-Act layoff settlement, and construction-dispute litigation. This is a clustered red-flag pattern: bad accounting and bad operating outcome on the same flagship US asset. Combined with the prior 2021 SPAC-period restatement of Tuscan/Microvast financials, this is a repeat-restater pattern. SEVERE_UNDERDELIVERY for governance and controls.
